import json,re,subprocess,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("artifacts/research/manuscript_review_20261030/utility_v6_skillcommit_author_year_v15_20261104")
out={}
for lang,page_index in (("en",7),("zh",6)):
